# proxmox_qemu_cloudinit_pending (Resource)

Writes pending cloud-init values through `PUT /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/cloudinit/pending`. The endpoint has no read counterpart, so refresh keeps the last applied values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_qemu_cloudinit_pending" "ci" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  vmid     = 300
  values   = { ciuser = "admin" }
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)
- `values` (Map of String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
